_comment: Template for YOLOX/YOLOv8 with event representation (VTEI, voxel_grid, etc.) as PNG

_key_flags.event_representation: vtei, voxel_grid, shist, mdes, or ev_temporal_volume - applied before PNG output
_key_flags.bins: Number of temporal bins for the representation (e.g., 10 for VTEI creates 10 channels)
_key_flags.store_as_hdf5: false - Store as PNG images (not HDF5)
_key_flags.filter_classes: List of class names to filter (e.g. ['person']). Original COCO IDs preserved.
